source: Bounce Tales original JAR bytecode: o.e(int), o.d(int,int), o.keyPressed(int), o.keyReleased(int); m.a(int), m.b(int); c.b(), c.c(), c.a(boolean), c.f().

primary_actor_action.source: if any o.a(code) is held, m calls c.a(false)
primary_actor_action.meaning: The bytecode proves this is the primary actor action path; the exact player-facing label (jump/action) is not conclusively named in obfuscated code.

cycle_actor_mode.source: m.b(20) conditionally calls c.f(); c.f() increments c.d, wraps at 2 and clamps against m.a().

pause_menu.source: m.b(5) sets a transition flag; the next m.a(int) update calls m.g(25). m.g(25) builds a menu headed by language string ID 83.

hash.finding: Not consumed by the traced active-gameplay input polling/dispatch branches. It may still have a menu/text/platform use; do not add it as a required gameplay control based on this evidence.

caveat: This is the original input dispatcher and active gameplay call map, not a completed browser game engine.
